Name: _ShowValueForDates
Expression:
VAR __LastDateWithData =
    CALCULATE (
        MAXX ( { MAX ( 'Data Refresh'[CurrentDateTime] ), MAX ( 'Data Refresh'[Date] ) }, ''[Value] ),
        REMOVEFILTERS ()
    )
VAR __FirstDateVisible =
    MIN ( 'Date'[Date] )
VAR __Result =
    __FirstDateVisible <= __LastDateWithData
RETURN
    __Result
